sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Move agent to increase purple, checking for pink blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
purple = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
white = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W']
agent = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
print(f"Start: purple={purple[0]['pixels']}, white={white[0]['pixels']}")
print(f"Agent: {agent[0]['boundary']}")

moves_needed = 27
moves_done = 0
direction = 'RIGHT'

for i in range(50):  # Max 50 moves
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    purple = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
    white = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W']
    pink = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'P']
    green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    
    if white[0]['pixels'] <= 0:
        print(f"White reached 0! Purple={purple[0]['pixels']}")
        break
    
    if pink:
        print(f"PINK BLOCK appeared! Stopping.")
        break
    
    if green:
        print(f"Green blocks spawned: {len(green)}")
        # Clear them
        for g in green:
            rows = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
            cols = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
            center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
            center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
            result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
        continue
    
    result = action([direction])
    moves_done += 1
    
    # Check result
    if result.get('game_over'):
        print(f"Game over after {moves_done} moves!")
        break
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        print(f"Level completed after {moves_done} moves!")
        break
    
    # Toggle direction occasionally to stay in bounds
    if i % 10 == 9:
        direction = 'LEFT' if direction == 'RIGHT' else 'RIGHT'
    
    if (i + 1) % 5 == 0:
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        purple = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
        white = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W']
        print(f"  Move {moves_done}: purple={purple[0]['pixels']}, white={white[0]['pixels']}")

# Final state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
purple = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p']
white = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W']
green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
pink = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'P']
print(f"\nFinal: purple={purple[0]['pixels']}, white={white[0]['pixels']}, green={len(green)}, pink={len(pink)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
